limitations: Eight predictions from two sources and one noise setting. Gains are fit over each256px tile and may vary with content/clipping/noise correlations; no broad real-image, seam, saturated-color or quality validation. Not a proposed default or trained-model improvement.
decision: No default change. Input-only gain largely reduces this fabric color shift but does not recover fine cords; broader saturated/real/full-frame checks would be required.
